title: Turn an Idea Into a Plan
mascot_lines: You have a big idea, and that's the fun part.
But ideas can feel huge, so we chop them into 5 small steps we can finish.
Then we do those steps in order, one at a time.
Plans are allowed to change as you learn — that's how good plans grow.

tier2.rephrase: Order the steps from idea to finished game.

tier3.nudge: Idea first. Then plan. Then build. Then test. Then SHARE!
